notes:
v2.4.2 makes Report an Issue easy to find and fixes bank reconciliation CSV presets.

Report an Issue is now a button at the end of the quick-nav bar on every page. It opens a short form without leaving the page and adds the page you were on to the report. Admins also get a Report an Issue tile in the Admin hub.

Bank reconciliation CSV import: presets now remember "Data starts row", and loading a preset replaces the whole mapping, so a guessed column can no longer override it. When one of your presets is selected, ↻ Update preset saves the current mapping into it.

Also: quick-nav labels no longer overlap on narrow windows, and the Getting Started guide has a new "Reporting a Problem" section.
